scope: Reviewed exact entities plus narrowly defined historical business-name patterns for eight builder collections. Neither legal succession nor construction of the current home is inferred.
normalization: Uppercase, collapse whitespace, remove periods and commas. Exact aliases are preferred. Pattern collections require the explicit brand spellings and business terms documented in limits; surname-only, lookalike, investment-only and successor-brand matches are excluded.

entities.name: Historical Steve or Steven Burnstead-named construction company
Conner Homes or Conner Development-named company

limits.burnstead: County sale associations for the three documented current LLCs plus historical seller names containing Burnstead and an explicit construction or homes business term, 1976–September 4, 2026. The historical names are grouped for discovery without asserting legal succession or that the named company built the current home.
limits.murray-franklyn: County sale associations for seller names containing Murray Franklyn or the Murray Franklin spelling variant plus an explicit homes, development, land-acquisition, west, or incorporated business term, 1976–September 4, 2026. These associations do not certify the original builder.
limits.camwest: County sale associations for seller names containing CamWest or Cam West plus an explicit development, homes, incorporated, LLC, or named-project business term, through September 4, 2026. These associations do not certify the original builder.
limits.conner: County sale associations limited to explicit Conner Homes, Conner Development, or Conner-Jarvis seller names through September 4, 2026. Generic Conner surname matches are excluded.
limits.toll-brothers: County sale associations for explicit Toll Brothers or Toll Bros seller names through September 4, 2026. These associations do not certify the original builder.
limits.mainvue: County sale associations for explicit MainVue or Main Vue seller names through September 4, 2026. These associations do not certify the original builder.
limits.lennar: County sale associations limited to explicit Lennar Northwest seller names through September 4, 2026. Lennart and other surname lookalikes are excluded.
limits.quadrant: Initial collection covers five reviewed corporate-name forms through 2020. Misspellings, other entities, combined sellers and 2021 onward transactions await review. Tri Pointe successor transactions are not automatically attributed to the historical Quadrant brand.
